title: Enforcement and defense of claims.
bodyText:
(a) A trustee shall take reasonable steps to enforce claims of the trust and to defend claims against the trust.

(b) A trustee may abandon or assign to one or more of the beneficiaries of the trust any claim that it believes is not prudent to enforce.
bodyHtml:
[§554D-811]  Enforcement and defense of claims.  (a)  A trustee shall take reasonable steps to enforce claims of the trust and to defend claims against the trust.

     (b)  A trustee may abandon or assign to one or more of the beneficiaries of the trust any claim that it believes is not prudent to enforce. [L 2021, c 32, pt of §2]
